text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of her debut arrives, but with everyone fussing over her, Sweep Tosho ends up feeling mollycoddled and frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To make matters worse, moments before the race, a fussy phone call from her father sparks an explosion of anger. I feel worried as I send Sweep Tosho off to race.
